dialogues.jp:
「たまにはひとり、静かな所で食事というのも
　悪くないな」
dialogues.en:
"It's not too bad having lunch alone somewhere nice and
quiet."
dialogues.text:
"It's not too bad having lunch alone somewhere nice and
quiet."

dialogues.jp:
まだ暖かいとはいえない気候の中庭には、俺の
ような物好きは他にいない。
dialogues.en:
No one else was out in the garden because of the nippy
weather.
dialogues.text:
No one else was out in the garden because of the nippy
weather.

dialogues.jp: 購買で買った焼きそばパンにかぶりつく。
dialogues.en:
I bit into the chow mein sandwich that I bought from the
store.
dialogues.text:
I bit into the chow mein sandwich that I bought from the
store.

dialogues.jp: 授業の疲れが吹き飛ぶ瞬間だ。
dialogues.en: This is how I could relieve my stress away from the classes.
dialogues.text: This is how I could relieve my stress away from the classes.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「本当にここにいるの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure it's here?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure it's here?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「たぶん……いるとしたら、ここだと思うんだ
　けど……」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... I think it should be here."
dialogues.text: "Yes...... I think it should be here."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「んっ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
ベンチ越しに振り向くと、クーラーボックスを
肩から提げた萌先輩と眞子の姿が見えた。
dialogues.en:
When I looked behind the bench, I saw Moe-sempai and Mako
with a cooler box.
dialogues.text:
When I looked behind the bench, I saw Moe-sempai and Mako
with a cooler box.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりともなにやら周囲の地面に目を凝らし、
何かを探しているようだった。
dialogues.en:
They were both staring at the ground and looking for
something.
dialogues.text:
They were both staring at the ground and looking for
something.

dialogues.jp: 「……何してんだ？」
dialogues.en: "......What are they doing?"
dialogues.text: "......What are they doing?"

dialogues.jp:
地面に目をやりながら、ふたりがこっちに近づ
いてくる。
dialogues.en: The two came toward me while looking down at the ground.
dialogues.text: The two came toward me while looking down at the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは。何してるの？」
dialogues.en: "Hello. What are you two doing?"
dialogues.text: "Hello. What are you two doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それが、お姉ちゃんが持ってきた食材が逃げ
　たらしくて、捜してんのよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, one of the ingredients my sister brought escaped, and
we're looking for it."
dialogues.text:
"Well, one of the ingredients my sister brought escaped, and
we're looking for it."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 食材が……逃げる？
dialogues.en: The ingredient...... escaped?
dialogues.text: The ingredient...... escaped?

dialogues.jp:
思わず、大根や白菜に足が生えて猛ダッシュを
かましているシーンを想像してしまう。
dialogues.en: I imagine a radish or napa cabbage running away on legs.
dialogues.text: I imagine a radish or napa cabbage running away on legs.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、生きたヤツを持ってきたらしいんだ
　けど、昼休みに屋上に行ったらいなくなって
　たみたいで……」
dialogues.en:
"I guess she brought the one that's alive, but it was gone
when we got to the roof top for lunch."
dialogues.text:
"I guess she brought the one that's alive, but it was gone
when we got to the roof top for lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「生きた？」
dialogues.en: "The one that's alive......?"
dialogues.text: "The one that's alive......?"

dialogues.jp: それは……何というか……。
dialogues.en: What can I say......?
dialogues.text: What can I say......?

dialogues.jp: 「……スゴイですね」
dialogues.en: "......It's amazing."
dialogues.text: "......It's amazing."

dialogues.jp: ――としか言えない。
dialogues.en: ...That's all I could think of to say.
dialogues.text: ...That's all I could think of to say.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ホントにどこ行ってしまったんでしょう……」
dialogues.en: "I wonder where it went......"
dialogues.text: "I wonder where it went......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、早く捜さないと」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, we have to look for it!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, we have to look for it!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、他の連中に見つかったら、騒ぎになる
　かもな。そうしたら講師に大目玉で――」
dialogues.en:
"Right. If the other kids find it, it would be chaos. Also,
the teachers would be very mad......"
dialogues.text:
"Right. If the other kids find it, it would be chaos. Also,
the teachers would be very mad......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「違うわよ！　お昼が食べられなくなっちゃう
　でしょうが」
dialogues.en: "That's not it! I'm saying that we would miss our lunch!"
dialogues.text: "That's not it! I'm saying that we would miss our lunch!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「おまえ……意外と冷淡だな」
dialogues.en: "You're...... kind of cold."
dialogues.text: "You're...... kind of cold."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「だから、あんたも一緒に捜してくれる？」
dialogues.en: "Will you look for it with us?"
dialogues.text: "Will you look for it with us?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんで、俺がそんなかったるいことを……」
dialogues.en:
"Why the heck do I have to do something that's such a
pain......?"
dialogues.text:
"Why the heck do I have to do something that's such a
pain......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……私からもお願いします」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Please help us......"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Please help us......"

dialogues.jp: 眞子の隣で萌先輩が深々と頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Moe politely bowed at me.
dialogues.text: Moe politely bowed at me.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……まあ、萌先輩がそう言うなら」
dialogues.en: "Well...... If Moe-sempai's asking me......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... If Moe-sempai's asking me......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、何であたしの時と対応が違うのよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey! Why is your reaction different all of a sudden?"
dialogues.text: "Hey! Why is your reaction different all of a sudden?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、萌先輩には色々と世話になってること
　もあるし」
dialogues.en: "Well, Moe-sempai's been really good to me......"
dialogues.text: "Well, Moe-sempai's been really good to me......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしには恩はないっての？」
dialogues.en: "You're saying you don't owe me anything?"
dialogues.text: "You're saying you don't owe me anything?"

dialogues.jp: 俺、Ｍじゃないし……。
dialogues.en: I'm not masochistic......
dialogues.text: I'm not masochistic......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ま、眞子ちゃん。暴力は待って」
dialogues.en: "Hey Mako-chan, don't be violent."
dialogues.text: "Hey Mako-chan, don't be violent."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が眞子を鎮めてくれる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai tried to calm Mako down.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai tried to calm Mako down.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「別に本気じゃないわよ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm not being serious......"
dialogues.text: "I'm not being serious......"

dialogues.jp: いや、そんなことはないと俺は思うぞ。
dialogues.en: That's what she says, but I think she was pretty serious.
dialogues.text: That's what she says, but I think she was pretty serious.

dialogues.jp:
「まあともかく、早く捜そう。時間も限られて
　るしな」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, let's start looking. we don't have much time."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, let's start looking. we don't have much time."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「で、萌先輩。その逃げた“食材”ってどんな
　やつなんです」
dialogues.en:
"......So Moe-sempai, what exactly is the ingredient that
escaped?"
dialogues.text:
"......So Moe-sempai, what exactly is the ingredient that
escaped?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「これぐらいの大きさのなんですが……」
dialogues.en: "It's about this size......"
dialogues.text: "It's about this size......"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、手で大きさを説明する――そんな
に大きくない……ウサギぐらいか？
dialogues.en:
She spoke and showed me with her hands. It's not that
big...... perhaps about the size of a rabbit.
dialogues.text:
She spoke and showed me with her hands. It's not that
big...... perhaps about the size of a rabbit.

dialogues.jp: でもそれだけじゃ分からん。
dialogues.en: However, that's not enough.
dialogues.text: However, that's not enough.

dialogues.jp: 「名前は？」
dialogues.en: "What's the name?"
dialogues.text: "What's the name?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それが、変わった名前で、よく覚えてないん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it has a weird name, and I don't really
remember......"
dialogues.text:
"Well, it has a weird name, and I don't really
remember......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "You don't......?"
dialogues.text: "You don't......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「でも、大丈夫です。毒はありませんから」
dialogues.en: "But it's okay. It's not poisonous."
dialogues.text: "But it's okay. It's not poisonous."

dialogues.speaker: Junichi & Mako
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
毒がないってことは――毒があるやつもいるっ
てことだよな……。
dialogues.en:
That means...... it could be poisonous depending on what
kind it is......?
dialogues.text:
That means...... it could be poisonous depending on what
kind it is......?

dialogues.jp: な、何を持ってきたんですか先輩ッ！？
dialogues.en: What the heck did she bring?
dialogues.text: What the heck did she bring?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたし、今日お昼抜きでいいや」
dialogues.en: "I don't need any lunch today."
dialogues.text: "I don't need any lunch today."

dialogues.jp:
きょとんとする萌先輩を置いて、眞子がそそく
さと退散していく。
dialogues.en: Mako left in a hurry while Moe-sempai remained standing.
dialogues.text: Mako left in a hurry while Moe-sempai remained standing.

dialogues.jp: 俺も逃げたい……。
dialogues.en: I want to go too......
dialogues.text: I want to go too......

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の期待の眼差しを受けながら、天を仰ぐ。
dialogues.en:
I looked up at the sky as Moe-sempai stared at me with hope
in her eyes.
dialogues.text:
I looked up at the sky as Moe-sempai stared at me with hope
in her eyes.

dialogues.jp: 俺……ここで死ぬのかな。
dialogues.en: Is today my last day......?
dialogues.text: Is today my last day......?

dialogues.jp: ◆逃げてしまった食材◆
dialogues.en: ◆The ingredient that escaped◆
dialogues.text: ◆The ingredient that escaped◆

dialogues.jp:
中庭でメシを食っていると、萌先輩と眞子が
やって来た。
dialogues.en:
When I was eating lunch in the garden, Moe-sempai and Mako
showed up.
dialogues.text:
When I was eating lunch in the garden, Moe-sempai and Mako
showed up.

dialogues.jp:
何でも、逃げた食材を探しているらしいのだ
が……。一体、何を持ってきたんです？　萌
先輩。
dialogues.en:
They were looking for an ingredient that escaped...... What
the heck did you bring, Moe-sempai?
dialogues.text:
They were looking for an ingredient that escaped...... What
the heck did you bring, Moe-sempai?
